users.title: Users
users.description: Roles, university affiliation and account status. Visible to the programme coordinator only.
users.createHint: Share the initial password through a secure channel; the user should change it after first sign-in.

fields.name: Full name
fields.title: Title / position
fields.titleHint: e.g. Team lead, Professor, Software engineer
fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Stored only as a hash.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.self: You cannot deactivate your own account or change your own admin role.
errors.emailTaken: A user with this email already exists
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.rootOnly: Only root (the system owner) can perform this action.
errors.rootProtected: The root account is protected and cannot be changed.

users.selfNote: You cannot deactivate your own account.
users.selfRoleNote: You cannot change your own admin role.
users.deactivateBody: The user will no longer be able to sign in. Their data and activity history are kept; you can reactivate the account at any time.
users.activateBody: The user will be able to sign in again with their existing password.
users.linkedShort: {count, plural, one {# project link} other {# project links}}
users.privacyNote: Data minimisation: only what is needed to take part in the programme is stored — name, email, role, title and university. No ID numbers, phone numbers or addresses are collected. Deactivated accounts are not deleted so that the audit log stays complete.

root.lockedRoot: Root account is protected — only root can edit it
root.lockedAdmin: Coordinator accounts are managed by root only

capabilities.c1: Only root can create, change and deactivate coordinator (admin) accounts
capabilities.c2: The root account cannot be deactivated or have its role changed by anyone
capabilities.c3: Protected by its own password, separate from the demo password; every action is logged

system.title: System administration
system.description: Database overview, role assignment and irreversible delete operations. Only the system owner (root) can see this page.

db.title: Database
db.subtitle: Current number of records per table

roles.title: Role assignment
roles.body: Root can assign any role to any user, including granting and revoking the coordinator (admin) role. On the Users page, choose “Edit” from a row's menu.

project.title: Delete a project permanently
project.body: Deletes the project with its tasks, sessions, checklist, documents (including files), risks and evaluations. The application record is kept.
project.hint: Type the project code exactly to delete.

application.title: Delete an application permanently
application.body: Deletes the application and its selection evaluations. A project created from it is kept.
application.hint: Type the application code exactly to delete.

user.title: Delete {name} permanently?
user.body: The account is removed from the database, together with team membership, mentor/jury assignments, their mentor sessions and evaluations; documents they uploaded stay with the project. This cannot be undone — deactivating is usually enough.
user.hint: Type the e-mail address exactly to delete.

wipe.title: Delete all program data
wipe.body: Deletes all users (except root), applications, projects, tasks, documents, risks, evaluations, notifications and the audit log. This cannot be undone.
wipe.keeps: Kept: root account, universities, competitions, rubrics
wipe.removes: Deleted: everything else and uploaded files
wipe.hint: To reload demo data, run on the server: npm run db:seed

errors.rootOnly: Only root can perform this action.
errors.confirm: The confirmation text does not match.
errors.rootProtected: The root account cannot be deleted.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

system.auditNote: Every delete operation is written to the audit log (who, when, what).
